title: StockSmart Demand Planning Note — Vend History Age and the Opening Level of a New Consigned Bin
content:
**Scope.** Opening consigned stock of a new StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines. An item with only a short vend history at its machine opens the bin lower.

**Rule.** Where every vend of the transferred item recorded at the demand machine is of age below three months, the opening level is the bin's reorder point; where every such vend is of age below six months but at least one is three months old or older, the opening level is half (0.5 times) the sum of the bin's reorder point and its fill-to level; an item with no vend there counts as having every vend below three months. An item with any vend six months old or older is not re-levelled under this note.

**Terms.** The demand machine is the machine of the customer's most recent VendPoint selection removal of the item made at the customer's request. A vend's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the vend's day of the month; below 3 means age 0, 1 or 2, and below 6 means age 0 to 5. The reorder point is the highest any of the bin's par level entries carries; the fill-to level is the one on its new-bin entry.

| Oldest vend of the item at the demand machine | Opening level |
|---|---|
| no vend at all | the bin's reorder point |
| age 0, 1 or 2 | the bin's reorder point |
| age 3, 4 or 5 | half the sum of the reorder point and the fill-to level |
| age 6 or more | not re-levelled under this note |

**Hypothetical bin, reorder point 10 and fill-to level 30.** All vends within age 2: opening level 10. Oldest vend of age 4: half of 40, that is 20. Oldest vend of age 7: this note does not apply.
